name: The Plumbing Machines
pain_point: Phone number prominent on homepage but no automated text-back or AI assistant — missed calls go unanswered after hours
outreach_angle: Their site lists a phone but no way for a customer to self-book or get a response outside business hours

name: HD Plumbing
pain_point: Residential and commercial plumber with no automated follow-up — prospects who call after hours get voicemail and often call a competitor
outreach_angle: Serves both residential and commercial — every missed call is a potentially large job lost

name: Platero Parada Plumbing LLC
pain_point: Offers 24/7 emergency service but no automated text-back — emergency callers who hit voicemail will immediately try the next plumber
outreach_angle: 24/7 emergency promise but no AI to back it up after hours — high-value angle since emergency jobs pay premium rates

name: Early Bird Plumbing
pain_point: Has a 'Book Now' link but no AI to handle missed calls or qualify leads automatically — callers who hit voicemail have to navigate back to the website to book
outreach_angle: Already invested in online booking (Book Now button) — AI text-back is the natural missing piece to capture callers who never reach the form

name: Taylor Plumbing
pain_point: Lists two phone numbers — probably the owner's cell and office — but no automated system to handle overflow or after-hours calls
outreach_angle: Two phone lines suggests high call volume; an AI receptionist reduces burden on the owner's personal cell

name: Plumbing Service Company
pain_point: Family-owned with residential, commercial, and backflow services but no chatbot or automated text-back — wide service range means high call volume with no overflow handling
outreach_angle: Multiple service lines (residential, commercial, backflow) means diverse callers — AI can triage and route each one

name: CABS Heating & Air Conditioning
pain_point: Offers 24/7 emergency HVAC service but no AI to respond to after-hours calls — during peak summer AC season a missed call is hundreds of dollars lost
outreach_angle: 24/7 emergency claim with no automated backup — summer AC rush is prime season for missed-call losses

name: Big Mountain Heating & Air
pain_point: Serves Sacramento, Auburn, and Truckee — wide coverage area means the owner can't personally answer every call from three markets
outreach_angle: Multi-location coverage with one phone line — AI receptionist handles all three markets simultaneously

name: RJA Heating and Air Conditioning
pain_point: Residential and commercial HVAC with no chatbot — 'Schedule an Appointment' button leads to a form, but callers who can't reach someone by phone rarely fill out a web form
outreach_angle: Has an appointment scheduler but no bridge between a missed call and that scheduler — AI text-back closes the gap

name: Airflow Heating & Air
pain_point: Family-owned HVAC with a 'Get a Free Estimate' CTA but no automated text-back — estimate requests that come in by phone after hours are lost
outreach_angle: Free estimate is their lead magnet — AI can capture estimate requests 24/7 via text so no lead slips through

name: Jaguar Heating & Air
pain_point: Family-owned, offers duct cleaning and mini-splits — specialty services attract price-sensitive callers who will quickly move on if no one answers
outreach_angle: Specialty services (mini-splits, duct cleaning) attract shoppers who call multiple companies — first to respond wins the job

name: AIR TECH Heating & A/C Service
pain_point: Commercial refrigeration in addition to HVAC — commercial clients expect fast response; no automated acknowledgement sends a weak signal
outreach_angle: Commercial clients (restaurants, stores) need fast response SLAs — AI text-back sets expectations and buys time for the technician to call back
